combinedTraceInitial.note: Original check rejected despite matching captured values. Separate comparison failure pattern; root cause unproven.

interpretation: Missing-value failure lies after Rust's recorded count computation and before the correct JS sentinel decoding. This does not yet distinguish compiled optional-result lowering from WebKit execution/return transfer. Rust reference address and JS wrapper handle are different representations; their four-byte difference is not claimed as pointer corruption. Matching-value rejection remains a separate unresolved observable pattern.
decisions: Preserve both failure patterns rather than treating transport-only candidates as complete fixes
Do not add fallback counts, retry getters or weaken admission
Use captured post-Rust mismatch to guide the next boundary change and verify it against both patterns
